name: Diotrephes
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not. So Diotrephes loved the preeminence. Preeminence is pride, ego. Preeminence is you thinking you are better than everybody. I am better than everyone, to hell with the apostles. That is what this dude was on. I am better than these dudes; do not even let them up in here. Yo, Peter, do not let that dude in here, who does he think he is? That is how this dude was rolling.

note.label: The Mind of a Child: Void of Ego and Pride

points: Another type of a hireling: Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not. You know what's strange? The apostles set this man up. So what was he doing? He was always around, made it appear like he was in the truth.

note.label: Living Your Life As A Hireling

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Diotrephes
